CLAIM: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 2 is an autosomal recessive condition caused by mutations in CEP57; this report adds a homozygous likely-pathogenic c.834_844dupCAATGTTCAGC variant with confirmed parental heterozygosity.
MODEL_SYSTEM: single patient case report (6-year-old child of consanguineous parents)
OBSERVED_EFFECT: severe short stature, dysmorphic features, mild intellectual disability with biallelic CEP57 variant
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. A single case establishes causality for the syndrome, not a tractable modulation direction; the abstract also notes growth hormone therapy shows limited response and that cancer predisposition requires further study.

CLAIM: Biallelic truncating CENATAC (CCDC84) mutations were identified in patients with constitutional mosaic aneuploidy.
MODEL_SYSTEM: exome sequencing of patients with constitutional mosaic aneuploidy
OBSERVED_EFFECT: biallelic truncating variants in constitutional mosaic aneuploidy
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. Truncating biallelic variants imply loss of function; the study does not report a therapeutic perturbation.

CLAIM: CENATAC depletion or expression of disease mutants caused excessive retention of AT-AN minor introns in about 100 genes enriched for cell-cycle regulators and produced chromosome segregation errors.
MODEL_SYSTEM: human cells with CENATAC depletion or disease-mutant expression
PERTURBATION: CENATAC depletion or expression of patient-derived disease mutants
OBSERVED_EFFECT: excessive minor intron retention with chromosome segregation errors
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. The abstract reports loss-of-function and segregation errors, not restoration; no dose, duration or rescue measurement is reported.

CLAIM: Compound heterozygous SMC5 variants predicted to disrupt SMC5/6 complex function were found in a patient with near-tetraploidy (9.7%) and mosaic variegated aneuploidy (46.9%).
MODEL_SYSTEM: trio exome sequencing of one proband with karyotype and array-CGH confirmation
OBSERVED_EFFECT: near-tetraploidy and mosaic variegated aneuploidy with a milder phenotype than typical Atelis Syndrome
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. Atelis Syndrome is the established SMC5-related diagnosis; this report describes a milder presentation, so Atelis and MVA phenotype labels must stay distinct.

CLAIM: Pathogenic SLF2 and SMC5 variants cause Atelis Syndrome, an inherited bone marrow failure syndrome with early myelodysplastic syndrome predisposition.
MODEL_SYSTEM: longitudinal follow-up of patients with SLF2/SMC5 variants plus patient-derived iPSC models
OBSERVED_EFFECT: some patients developed MDS at a young age
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. The syndrome includes hematological failure; this is not a report of restored function.

CLAIM: Patient-specific iPSC-derived hematopoietic progenitors carrying compound heterozygous SLF2 mutations showed impaired colony-forming capacity and defective erythroid differentiation, with disruption of the SLF2-SMC5 axis inducing genomic instability, p53/p21 activation and a senescence-like phenotype.
MODEL_SYSTEM: patient-specific iPSC-derived hematopoietic progenitor cells and SMC5 knockdown in cord blood CD34+ cells
PERTURBATION: patient-derived compound heterozygous SLF2 mutations; SMC5 knockdown
OBSERVED_EFFECT: impaired colony formation, genomic instability, p53/p21 activation, senescence-like phenotype
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. Loss-of-function direction only; no restoration experiment and no dose or duration is reported.

CLAIM: Rare homozygous MAD1L1 variants (rs1639921, rs1481591257) were reported at significantly different frequencies in aneuploid products of conception compared with an ethnically matched reference database.
MODEL_SYSTEM: genotyping of 40 aborted fetuses with array-CGH-confirmed aneuploidy, compared with the Iranome database
OBSERVED_EFFECT: association between rare MAD1L1 variants and fetal aneuploidy
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. An association study: no loss- or gain-of-function mechanism is demonstrated, so the disease direction remains unresolved.

CLAIM: Transient TTK (MPS1) inhibition induced acute chromosomal instability in KIF18A-inhibitor-resistant small cell lung cancer models.
MODEL_SYSTEM: human small cell lung cancer cell lines and functional perturbation models
CELL_TYPE: small cell lung cancer cell lines
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. Cited in tumour cell culture, where induced instability was used to restore drug sensitivity; it is a cited worsening of chromosomal instability and is not evidence about constitutional MVA rescue.

MODEL_SYSTEM: human small cell lung cancer cell lines with live-cell imaging and genetic perturbation
CELL_TYPE: small cell lung cancer cell lines
PERTURBATION: KIF18A inhibition in SAC-proficient versus SAC-defective cells
OBSERVED_EFFECT: SAC-proficient cells sustained mitotic arrest and apoptosis; SAC-defective cells survived
CONTEXT_LIMITATION: ABSTRACT_ONLY: claim read from the abstract; full text not consulted. A tumour-cell dependency context: it does not establish the constitutional disease direction for BUB1B, and selective tumour-cell killing is not rescue of constitutional MVA.
